purpose: Hash-pinned transcription of the dated current Super Dragon table, whose eleven ordinal rows supersede the stale ten-row upstream superTroop payload.

damage_per_shot.derivation: 537 DPS × 1.8-second dated table cadence. This is deterministic aggregate damage per attack cycle, not evidence of a one-flame Roast animation or an individual burst impact.

observations.level_mapping: The current table has 11 ordinal rows. Its row 1 matches the lowest upstream Super Dragon level number 3 by ordering, so rows 1–11 map conservatively to imported levels 3–13; TH availability for the missing row is not claimed.
